// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1841): images wrapped with styled(Image), none with the prop.
import { Image } from 'react-native';
const Pic = styled(Image);
const Tall = styled(Image, { height: 200 });
const Photo2 = styled(Pic);
export function Bad({ uri }: { uri: string }) {
  return (
    <>
      <Pic source={{ uri }} />
      <Tall source={{ uri }} />
      <Photo2 source={{ uri }} />
    </>
  );
}
